title: Performance gate passes although the ETL report lists a slower row
requirement: The performance gate exits 0 when the ETL comparison lists a slower, interesting row and fail_on_regression is on. Read evidence/failure-report.txt, find the cause, and fix it so the gate exits 1 for that input. Keep the rule that a clean ETL comparison marks a benchmark regression as noise.
invariants: a clean ETL comparison still marks a benchmark regression as noise
the gate decides from EtlResult fields and never parses the report text
a failed ETL comparison falls back to the benchmark verdict
acceptance_criteria: compare_etl reports a slower, interesting row as a regression
compare_etl ignores faster rows and rows that are not interesting
decide exits 1 for an ETL regression when fail_on_regression is on
decide still exits 0 for a benchmark regression that a clean ETL comparison contradicts

reset.notes: Copy initial/ into an empty directory; delete that directory after grading.

provenance.reference: rjmurillo/moq.analyzers issue 1265. Only the meaningful invariant is kept (an ETL verdict must reach the gate without hiding benchmark regressions), re-expressed as a small Python package. The shipped fix is not copied.
